title: PagedBlacklistedAccountResponse
description: Page of blacklist entries returned by `GetBlacklistPaged`. Always empty on a freshly deployed contract.

start_next_after.description: Field indicating paging information for the following queries if the caller wishes to get further entries.

BlacklistedAccount.description: Public-key + metadata pair surfaced by `GetBlacklistedAccount` / `GetBlacklistPaged`. Always empty on a freshly deployed contract.

Blacklisting.description: Per-key blacklist record: the multisig proposal that approved it and the block height at which finalisation landed (None until finalised).
